data.name: Dheeraj
data.long_meaning: Dheeraj derives from the Sanskrit word ‘dheerah’, meaning ‘brave’, ‘strong’, and ‘radiant’. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a celestial being, Indra, who is the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. Dheeraj is a powerful and auspicious name, often given to boys to bless them with courage, strength, and prosperity.
